name: actuo
description: AI-native expense intelligence platform with a universal WebMCP Copilot

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n backend,frontend,partner -c blue,magenta,yellow "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:partner"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend && npm run build:seo
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@actuo/shared && npm run test --workspace=backend && npm run test --workspace=frontend
